# Automated tests. Each executable covers one area; all use Qt Test and run
# headless (no GUI): the core library has no widget dependency.

set(LOCALFLIX_TEST_ENV
    "PATH=path_list_prepend:$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Qt6::Core>"
    "QT_QPA_PLATFORM=set:offscreen"
    "QT_LOGGING_RULES=set:localflix.*=false")

# localflix_add_test(<name> <source> [LIBS ...])
function(localflix_add_test name source)
    cmake_parse_arguments(T "" "" "LIBS" ${ARGN})
    add_executable(${name} ${source} TestSupport.h)
    target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE localflix_core Qt6::Test ${T_LIBS})
    target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
    localflix_set_warnings(${name})
    # also keep the full Qt Test report in build/test-logs (ctest only shows part of it)
    add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name} -o -,txt -o ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/test-logs/${name}.txt,txt)
    set_tests_properties(${name} PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION "${LOCALFLIX_TEST_ENV}"
        TIMEOUT 120)
endfunction()

localflix_add_test(tst_parser tst_parser.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_database tst_database.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_library tst_library.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_progress tst_progress.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_playback tst_playback.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_skip tst_skip.cpp)
localflix_add_test(tst_tracks tst_tracks.cpp)

# Integration test against the real libmpv engine. It needs the synthetic clips
# from scripts/make_test_videos.py (generated by the fixture below when Python
# and tools/mpv-cli/mpv.exe are available; otherwise the test skips itself).
localflix_add_test(tst_mpv_backend tst_mpv_backend.cpp LIBS localflix_mpv)
target_compile_definitions(tst_mpv_backend PRIVATE LOCALFLIX_TESTDATA_DIR="${MEDIA_SUITE_TESTDATA_DIR}")
add_custom_command(TARGET tst_mpv_backend POST_BUILD
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${LOCALFLIX_MPV_DLL}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:tst_mpv_backend>"
    VERBATIM)
set_tests_properties(tst_mpv_backend PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 300)

find_package(Python3 QUIET COMPONENTS Interpreter)
if(Python3_FOUND AND EXISTS "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/mpv-cli/mpv.exe")
    add_test(NAME make_test_videos COMMAND ${Python3_EXECUTABLE} -I "${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts/make_test_videos.py")
    set_tests_properties(make_test_videos PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP test_videos TIMEOUT 300)
    set_tests_properties(tst_mpv_backend PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED test_videos)
endif()

# End-to-end UI test (§16 acceptance scenario through the real window, real libmpv).
# Needs a desktop session, so it does not use the offscreen platform and runs alone.
option(LOCALFLIX_BUILD_GUI_TESTS "Build the desktop UI end-to-end test" ON)
if(LOCALFLIX_BUILD_GUI_TESTS)
    localflix_add_test(tst_ui_e2e tst_ui_e2e.cpp LIBS localflix_ui)
    target_sources(tst_ui_e2e PRIVATE ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/resources/resources.qrc)
    target_compile_definitions(tst_ui_e2e PRIVATE
        LOCALFLIX_TESTDATA_DIR="${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata/videos"
        LOCALFLIX_SHOT_DIR="${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/e2e-shots")
    add_custom_command(TARGET tst_ui_e2e POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "${LOCALFLIX_MPV_DLL}" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:tst_ui_e2e>"
        VERBATIM)
    set_tests_properties(tst_ui_e2e PROPERTIES
        ENVIRONMENT_MODIFICATION "PATH=path_list_prepend:$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:Qt6::Core>;QT_QPA_PLATFORM=reset:;QT_LOGGING_RULES=set:localflix.*=false"
        RUN_SERIAL TRUE
        TIMEOUT 400
        LABELS "gui")
    if(TEST make_test_videos)
        set_tests_properties(tst_ui_e2e PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED test_videos)
    endif()
endif()
